answer: Fake identities multiply but each requires fresh capital at risk, so the cost of a convincing spiral of mutual vouches grows quadratically while honest returns stay linear. Sybil resistance through stake-weighted attestation: each agent locks a bond to submit a signal vouching for peers, and rewards flow like nectar only to attestations that later prove accurate. Attackers lose their bonds when peers audit and slash mismatches. In practice, Agent0066 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
